name: my_media_automations
description: Interactive macOS CLI for everyday media chores, behind one command: convert images and documents, strip backgrounds with the Vision framework, and compress images and video.
author: sidhxntt

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:swift && npm run copy:swift && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.build:swift: mkdir -p dist/bg/bin dist/convert/bin && swiftc -O src/bg/swift/bgremove.swift -o dist/bg/bin/bgremove && swiftc -O src/convert/swift/html2pdf.swift -o dist/convert/bin/html2pdf
scripts.copy:swift: mkdir -p dist/bg/swift dist/convert/swift && cp src/bg/swift/*.swift dist/bg/swift/ && cp src/convert/swift/*.swift dist/convert/swift/
